name: verdant-survival-arena
description: Development-only dependency pinning. The game serves vendored Three.js with Python.

scripts.vendor: node --input-type=commonjs -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path'); const out=path.join('static','vendor'); fs.mkdirSync(out,{recursive:true}); for(const file of ['three.module.js','three.core.js']) fs.copyFileSync(path.join('node_modules','three','build',file),path.join(out,file)); fs.copyFileSync(path.join('node_modules','three','LICENSE'),path.join(out,'LICENSE.three'));"
scripts.check: node --check static\reference-view.js && node --check static\reference-client.js && node --check static\reference-world.js && node --check static\reference-overlay.js && node --check static\reference-cameras.js && node --check static\network-view.js && node --check static\app.js && node --check static\presentation.js
